title: Non-European Mathematics Manuscripts: Multilingual Translation Drafts and Modern LaTeX Sources
description:
Working corpus record for non-European and multilingual mathematical manuscripts in the Modern LaTeX Editions project. The record groups Chinese, Indian/Sanskrit, Islamic/Arabic, and historical-reference mathematical material as reader PDFs, TeX/source bundles, reference scans where available, OCR/audit material, and preservation archives.

Status at a glance.

  • Quality-screened top-level reader PDFs: [########--] 34 work-level PDFs / 1303 pages currently pass the automated open/text/visible-marker sweep and current visual spot checks.
  • Combined-reader rebuild status: [###-------] older combined readers and 48 top-level drafts are preserved in ZIP artifacts but not presented as the clean public surface until rebuilt.
  • Source/provenance preservation: [##########] TeX/source bundles, source/reference scans where available, OCR text, audit outputs, render samples, and superseded drafts are retained.
  • Proofreading/final edition status: [###-------] useful working drafts; not certified critical editions.

Top-level PDFs are intended for direct browsing and download. ZIP files contain source material, scans or reference material where available, OCR text, repair notes, superseded drafts, and provenance. The archive is being refined toward author/work-specific pages while this record remains the coherent corpus surface.
notes: Non-European and multilingual mathematics corpus record. This version presents only the stricter current work-level reader PDFs at top level, while preserving older combined readers, visually held drafts, source material, and superseded drafts in ZIP artifacts for provenance and rebuild work.
